heroHeadline:
UAP Disclosure:
House Task Force Hears Sworn 'Misrepresentation' Charge Against AARO as Pentagon Pursues Private Records Archive
heroSubtitle: Tracking official government actions, congressional hearings, declassified documents, and institutional statements on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena. Sept 9: the House Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets, chaired by Rep. Anna Paulina Luna, held its first UAP-focused hearing — sworn testimony from Air Force veterans Jeffrey Nuccetelli and Dylan Borland, active-duty Navy Chief Alexandro Wiggins, and journalist George Knapp. Borland told the task force AARO's public position is 'a misrepresentation of the truth.' Sept 2: AARO moved to sole-source a contract with the National UFO Historical Records Center for digital access to its pre-1990 archive, the largest private UAP records collection in North America, to satisfy AARO's 1945-forward congressional review mandate. These developments follow a summer of institutional activity: five PURSUE tranches (379 files through Aug 7), the White House UAP Science Advisory Council chaired by Avi Loeb, AARO's overdue FY2025 annual report, and House adoption of the UAP Disclosure Act as an FY2027 NDAA amendment. Next EO milestone: 300-day full-disclosure-or-justify deadline in late Nov/Dec 2026.
footerNote: This tracker documents official statements, legislative actions, and institutional processes related to UAP disclosure. It does not validate or endorse the claims contained within official testimonies. EDITORIAL NOTE: Events record that officials made specific claims — not that those claims are verified as factually true. All contested claims include opposing positions.
